model: GS3000 indoor Modbus carbon monoxide transmitter
applies_to: Johnson Controls GS3000 / GS3001 electrochemical CO transmitters with RS-485 Modbus RTU, per installation guide 24-11484-00021 (2020-10-01).
summary: Wall-mounted electrochemical carbon monoxide transmitter (0-500 ppm) for garages and plant rooms. It is a Modbus RTU subordinate with fixed 9600 8N1 serial settings and a DIP-switch address, and it exposes just two holding registers: sensor status and the CO reading in ppm.

addressing.note: Table 4 lists Modbus address 40001 with offset +0 and 40002 with offset +1, and the example query frames (Figure 11) send start address 0x0000 for status and 0x0001 for CO, so the wire addresses are 0 and 1.

source.title: GS3000 Indoor Modbus Carbon Monoxide Transmitter Installation Guide
source.pages: p. 3 (network communication, Table 1 DIP address), p. 4 (Tables 2-4 RTU format and register addressing), p. 6 (specifications)

notes: Source is Johnson Controls' documentation portal; the guide's PDF attachment is 241148400021.pdf.

Both registers are unsigned 16-bit words and read-only. Figure 11 shows both being read with function 03 (Read Holding Registers), one register per request; exception codes 01, 02 and 03 are returned for bad requests.
Serial settings other than the address are fixed at the factory (the guide notes they may be factory-customised).

integration.summary: Set a unique address on the 8-way DIP switch, wire A-/B+/shield, and poll holding registers 0-1 at 9600 8N1: status then CO in ppm.
integration.enable: Modbus is always on; set the address (1-255) with the DIP switch before connecting to the network.
quirks: Address is binary on DIP switches weighted 128-64-32-16-8-4-2-1.
Baud, parity and stop bits are fixed (9600, none, 1).
setup: Fit the PCB EOL jumper (121 ohm) only on the devices at each end of the segment.
Use 22 AWG shielded twisted pair; ground the shield at one end; max 4000 ft per segment.
gotchas: Half-wave power supply: keep the same circuit ground on all devices and the controller.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
